title: Seller Performance Standing — Voluntary Closure of the Selling Account and Points Carried Forward
content:
**Terms.** A seller may close the selling account voluntarily while the standing record is in good standing or at risk; closing is the seller's own act and is confirmed by the seller. Closing sets the record to closed with the closing date and books the retired points as a points-expiry entry; the points left on the record after it are the closed record's active points, which carry forward. A seller who closed voluntarily and returns gets a new record, which opens with the active points the closed record kept.

The retired points are fixed only after any top-performer relief owed on the evaluation day stands booked on the standing record. Equally, the retired points are settled on a Seller Performance Standing record on which any top-performer relief owed on the evaluation day already stands booked.

For closure, whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the closing date: a date lies in the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N whole months have passed from it to the closing date.

## What closing does

| Before closing | On closing | After closing |
|---|---|---|
| record in good standing or at risk | the record becomes closed, with the closing date; the retired points are booked as a points-expiry entry | the points left are the closed record's active points |
| — | — | a returning seller's new record opens with those active points |

## How the retired points are booked

The retired points are booked against the listing-type violation that still carries the most points, the oldest of them where two carry the same, and the entry carries that violation's type; where they exceed that violation's remaining points, the rest is booked the same way against the next listing-type violation and only then against serious violations.

**Hypothetical booking.** Retired points of 3; active violations: a listing policy violation with 2 points left, a restricted product violation with 4 points left and an intellectual property violation with 8 points left. The 3 points are booked against the restricted product violation, which carries the most points among the listing-type violations; the intellectual property violation is reached only once the listing-type violations are exhausted.

## Closing tool: `close_selling_account_c808e333`

**Capability.** The seller closes their own selling account on their performance standing record: the record's status becomes closed with today's date as the closing date, and the given number of violation points is retired as a points-expiry entry dated today against one policy violation. The standing record then shows status closed and the closing date, its active violation points drop by exactly the retired points, and the retirement entry appears in the seller's standing activity; the points left on the record are the closed record's active points.

**How it is invoked.** This is the seller's own tool. The agent unlocks it for the seller with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, under the tool name `close_selling_account_c808e333`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `standing_id` | Identifier: the reference number of the seller performance standing record being closed, as given to the seller by the support agent from the standing record lookup. |
| `violation_ref` | Identifier: the policy violation reference number the retirement entry is booked against, as given to the seller by the support agent from the standing activity. |
| `violation_type` | Enum: the kind of policy violation the retirement entry is booked against, copied from that violation's record; exactly one of `listing_policy`, `restricted_product`, `intellectual_property`, `inauthentic_complaint`, `product_authenticity`, `review_manipulation`. |
| `retired_points` | Fixed format: the number of violation points retired at closing, a whole number of points zero or above (integer points, no decimals), as worked out and told to the seller by the support agent. |

**Return.** A receipt with `standing_id` (the closed standing record), `status` (closed once the call succeeds), `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date), `entry_id` (reference of the retirement points-expiry entry), `retired_points`, `active_points_before` (active violation points before closing) and `active_points_after` (active violation points the closed record keeps). A returned status of closed means the selling account is closed.
